finding: Logical Block Addresses (LBAs) are 64 bits rather than 32 bits
note: 大于 2 TiB 的盘必须走 64 位 LBA

finding: Provides both a primary and backup partition table for redundancy
note: 写表必须同时维护两份；只写主表是破坏性降级

finding: Uses version number and size fields for future expansion
note: 未知 revision/size 不得按已知布局强解

finding: Uses CRC32 fields for improved data integrity
note: 头 CRC 与条目数组 CRC 分离

finding: Defines a GUID for uniquely identifying each partition; uses a GUID and attributes to define partition content type
note: 类型 GUID、唯一 GUID、属性三者独立

finding: Each partition contains a 36 character human readable name
note: 名字是 36 个 UTF-16 码元，不是字节

finding: Signature is 0xAA55: byte 510 contains 0x55 and byte 511 contains 0xAA; four 16-byte partition records; the rest of the logical block is reserved
note: 注意字节序：文档按字节描述，Microsoft 按字写成 0x55AA

finding: The Signature must be 0xaa55; a record with OSType zero or SizeInLBA zero may be ignored; otherwise each partition must reside on the disk and must not overlap
note: 这是“可忽略项”的规范来源；修复逻辑不得把空记录当有效分区

finding: BootIndicator and CHS fields shall not be used by UEFI firmware; StartingLBA and SizeInLBA are used to determine start and size
note: CHS 只影响旧系统兼容，不参与本实现的几何判定

finding: BootIndicator 0x00; StartingCHS 0x000200; OSType 0xEE; EndingCHS last logical block or 0xFFFFFF; StartingLBA 1; SizeInLBA disk size minus one or 0xFFFFFFFF; remaining records zero
note: 保护 MBR 的六字段全部是硬约束

finding: Unique MBR Disk Signature and Unknown fields unused and set to zero; Reserved set to zero; Signature 0xAA55
note: 与“保留旧 MBR 磁盘签名”的常见做法冲突，需明确策略

finding: Primary GPT Header must be in LBA 1; backup GPT Header must be in the last LBA; MyLBA is the header's own LBA and AlternateLBA is the other header's LBA
note: 最后 LBA 随盘容量变化，重写备份表前必须重新计算

finding: First Usable LBA through Last Usable LBA is inclusive; all data on the volume must be stored between them; only GPT management structures may reside outside
note: 分区条目落在可用区间外即非法

finding: The GPT Header's size may increase in the future but it cannot span more than one logical block
note: 解析时以 HeaderSize 为准，但必须小于等于扇区大小

finding: Entry array starts at Partition Entry LBA; element size is Size Of Partition Entry; count is Number Of Partition Entries
note: 三者与扇区大小共同决定数组跨度

finding: If the array size is not an even multiple of the logical block size, leftover space in the last block is reserved and not covered by the array CRC32
note: CRC 只覆盖 size*count；多算尾部保留区会导致校验失败

finding: When an entry is updated, the Partition Entry Array CRC32 must be updated; when that CRC is updated, the GPT Header CRC must also be updated
note: 顺序不可颠倒：先数组 CRC，后头 CRC

finding: Primary entry array is after the primary header and ends before First Usable LBA; backup entry array is after Last Usable LBA and ends before the backup header
note: 备份数组位置取决于盘尾几何

finding: Each defined partition must not overlap with any other defined partition; if all fields of an entry are zero, the entry is not in use
note: 全零条目是唯一合法的“空闲”表示

finding: A minimum of 16,384 bytes of space must be reserved for the GPT Partition Entry Array
note: 128 条目 × 128 字节是下限，不是上限

finding: With 512-byte blocks First Usable LBA must be at least 34 (1 MBR + 1 header + 32 array blocks); with 4096-byte blocks at least 6 (1 + 1 + 4)
note: 新表起点不得早于该下界

finding: GPT partitions should be aligned to the larger of the physical block boundary and the optimal transfer length granularity; examples show 512-byte logical / 4096-byte physical → multiples of 8
note: “should”不是 must；对齐策略需与旧工具默认 grain 对照

finding: The value of Disk GUID is a GUID that uniquely identifies the entire GPT Header and all its associated storage
note: 磁盘身份用于多盘识别，不等同于任何分区 GUID

finding: MBR contains master boot code, disk signature at 0x01B8, a 64-byte partition table at 0x01BE with four 16-byte entries, and a 2-byte signature word always 0x55AA
note: Windows 视角的偏移量与 UEFI 表一致，但签名按字描述

finding: When there are fewer than four partitions, the remaining partition table fields are set to zero
note: 与本实现的“全零即空闲”一致

finding: System ID 0x05 and 0x0F identify an extended partition; 0x0F is the BIOS INT 13h extensions form
note: 扩展分区类型码是识别 EBR 链的入口

finding: An extended boot record consists of an extended partition table and the signature word for the sector; it exists for each logical drive in the extended partition
note: EBR 是链式结构，不是单一表

finding: The EBR contains the only information on the first side of the first cylinder of each logical drive; the boot sector is usually at relative sector 32 or 63; if there is no extended partition there are no EBRs
note: CHS 位置只在旧系统有意义，但“每逻辑盘一个 EBR”是链长依据

finding: A signature word also marks the end of an extended boot record (EBR) and the boot sector
note: EBR 缺签名即不可继续沿链解析
